data.long_meaning: Anandhan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ananda', meaning joy, happiness, and bliss. In Hindu mythology, Ananda is a name of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe, who is often depicted as the embodiment of supreme joy and happiness. The name Anandhan carries the meaning “Joy, Happiness, Bliss” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anandhan usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, happiness, bliss and live with faith, good character and purpose.
